name: sbv2-ja-baseline

condition.text: こんにちは、musculus の世界へようこそ。

tolerance_policy.relative: regression if RTF p50 exceeds 0.199 * 1.15 on the same hardware and model revision
tolerance_policy.absolute: RTF p50 must stay below 1.0 (real time); latency p50 must stay below 2.0 s for this sentence

notes: RTF = wall time / audio duration; lower is better.
First run includes onnxruntime graph optimization warmup and is excluded.
The 220 ms p95 gap between runs is within run-to-run noise on this machine.
